title: Electric Makeup Brush Cleaner & Dryer
descriptionHtml:
Clean, dry brushes in minutes — no more scrubbing by hand.

Dirty brushes hold on to old makeup and oil, and that makes your application patchy. The ZALIN Electric Brush Cleaner spins your brushes clean in water and cleanser, then spins them dry, so they're ready to use again sooner.

Why you'll love it

  • Spins clean, then spins dry: one device does both jobs.
  • Fits different brush sizes: interchangeable rubber collars hold brushes of different handle sizes.
  • No more rubbing bristles on your palm: the motor does the work.
  • Cordless and rechargeable: built-in battery, no disposable batteries.
  • Tidy storage: comes with a stand to keep the device and collars together.

How to use

  1. Fill a cup or bowl with water and a little brush cleanser or gentle soap.
  2. Slide your brush into the collar that fits its handle and attach it to the spinner.
  3. Dip the bristles into the water and press the button to spin them clean.
  4. Lift the brush out of the water and spin again to dry.
